name: Fact Library
office_task: Keep one read-only company knowledge graph that every bot in the fleet asks, where nothing goes live until a named person accepts it and a replaced document takes its answers with it.
systems_of_record: the document store that issues the document_id for each source in the watched library folder (Drive, SharePoint)

the business's own graph store and library register, which hold sources with edition and checksum, nodes, edges, change deltas and the answers given (lists, Postgres or a graph database on the business's account)
the system of record that issues entity ids (the Xero contact, the CRM id, the ABN)
the exception desk the business runs, which issues the exception_id

emits.write: the change delta for a source whose checksum moved, written into the library register the knowledge owner opens: the source's document_id, the old and new checksum, and the computed list of every node built from it, each moved to change_pending
emits.readback: the library register returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the document_id, both checksums and the affected node ids; no id back means the delta was not written, kg.change_pending is raised to the named owner and no affected node answers

emits.write: an exception on the source or node naming the person who owns it: a source that is not an instrument, customer material offered as a source, an acceptance with no name or no locator, a type the key contract does not name, an entity with no system-of-record id and no accepted SAME_AS, two live nodes in conflict, a change pending acceptance, or a question no live node covers
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the document_id or node id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
